fields.name: FakeGrainStorageSerializer generic serializer stub
fields.contract: For every generic type T, Deserialize<T>(BinaryData input) returns default(T) and does not derive a value from input. Serialize<T>(T input) returns BinaryData.Empty and does not derive bytes from input. This is by design: ArgentSea maps grain state relationally to query parameters and result columns and never serializes it, so OrleansDbPersistenceOptions and OrleansShardPersistenceOptions default their GrainStorageSerializer to this stub to satisfy Orleans' storage-options contract.
